scope: engineering parity and speed measurement; not model performance evidence
method: Cache the pinned frozen transformer's last observed patch representation and reverse-RevIN statistics once per sample. Reconstruct the original full Linear input matrix shape before each trainable output-head call to preserve CPU float32 arithmetic exactly.
limitations: The speedup is for repeated output-head calls after one mandatory cache build per sample.
End-to-end fold runtime also includes data materialization, cache construction, validation inference, checkpointing and evaluation.
This changes execution efficiency only and does not establish better forecast accuracy.
